newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich to bid for rest of ZRC.
newsitem.headline: Zurich to bid for rest of ZRC.

text.p: Zurich Insurance Group said it is proposing to acquire the shares of Zurich Reinsurance Group Holdings Inc it does not already own for a price of $36 per share.
The price amounts to a total $322.5 million for roughly 9.0 million publicly-held shares, Zurich Insurance said.
As of the end of 1996 Zurich owned approximately 17.2 million ZRC common shares, or some 66 percent of the common stock outstanding.
Zurich noted that the proposed acquisition price represents an 18.5 percent premium over the closing price on Wednesday, January 8, 1997 of $30.375.
It said the offer is subject to the approval of its board and the shareholders of ZRC along with the other customary conditions.
The company also said it expects to close the transaction during the second quarter of 1997.
